# Ledger of the Grey Warden

A journal is a log written in the vault rather than in the chat panel. Its text is
derived from the **source** and excludes `[!secret]` content in every reveal
state, so a search over a journal cannot carry a secret to a reader who may not
see it.

## Entries

- **Day 1.** Arrived at the gate. The Warden would not let me past without the
  miller's word. See [[scene]].
- **Day 2.** The eastern signal fire is out, and nobody will say why.
- **Day 3.** [[bestiary/goblin|Three goblins]] on the north road, and a fourth
  set of tracks behind the mill.
